source_text: Ὡς οὖν ἀπὸ Ἀβραὰμ ἤρξατο περιτομὴ καὶ ἀπὸ Μωσέως σάββατον καὶ θυσίαι καὶ προσφοραὶ καὶ ἑορταὶ, καὶ ἀπεδείχθη διὰ τὸ σκληροκάρδιον τοῦ λαοῦ ὑμῶν ταῦτα διατετάχθαι, οὕτως παύσασθαι ἔδει κατὰ τὴν τοῦ πατρὸς βουλὴν εἰς τὸν διὰ τῆς ἀπὸ τοῦ γένους τοῦ Ἀδραὰμ καὶ φυλῆς Ἰούδα καὶ Δαυῒδ παρθένου γεννηθέντα υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ Χριστόν, ὅστις καὶ αἰώνιος νόμος καὶ καινὴ διαθήκη τῷ παντὶ κόσμῳ ἐκηρύσσετο προελευσόμενος, ὡς αἱ προλελεγμέναι προφητεῖαι σημαίνουσι. Καὶ ἡμεῖς, οἱ διὰ τούτου προσχωρήσαντες τῷ θεῷ, οὐ ταύτην τὴν κατὰ σάρκα παρελάβομεν περιτομήν, ἀλλὰ πνευματικήν , ἣν Ἐνὼχ καὶ οἱ ὅμοιοι ἐφύλαξαν· ἡμεῖς δὲ διὰ τοῦ βαπτίσματος αὐτήν, ἐπειδὴ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἐγεγόνειμεν, διὰ τὸ ἔλεος τὸ παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐλάβομεν, καὶ πᾶσιν ἐφετὸν ὁμοίως λαμβάνειν. Περὶ δὲ τοῦ τῆς γενέσεως αὐτοῦ μυστηρίου ἤδη λέγειν κατεπείγοντος λέγω. Ἡσαΐας οὖν περὶ τοῦ γένους αὐτοῦ τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὅτι ἀνεκδιήγητόν ἐστιν ἀνθρώποις, οὕτως ἔφη ὡς καὶ προγέγραπται· Τὴν γενεὰν αὐτοῦ τίς διηγήσεται; Ὅτι αἴρεται ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἡ ζωὴ αὐτοῦ, ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνομιῶν τοῦ λαοῦ μου ἤχθη εἰς θάνατον . Ὡς ἀνεκδιηγήτου οὖν ὄντος τοῦ γένους τούτου ἀποθνήσκειν μέλλοντος, ἵνα τῷ μώλωπι αὐτοῦ ἰαθῶμεν οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἄνθρωποι, τὸ προφητικὸν πνεῦμα ταῦτα εἶπεν. Ἔτι καὶ ἵνα ὃν τρόπον γέγονεν ἐν κόσμῳ γεννηθεὶς ἐπιγνῶναι ἔχωσιν οἱ πιστεύοντες αὐτῷ ἄνθρωποι, διὰ τοϋ αὐτοῦ Ἡσαίου τὸ προφητικὸν πνεῦμα ὡς μέλλει γίνεσθαι προεφήτευσεν οὕτως· Καὶ προσέθετο κύριος λαλῆσαι τῷ Ἄχαζ, λέγων· Αἴτησον σεαυτῷ σημεῖον παρὰ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου εἰς βάθος ἢ εἰς ὕψος. Καὶ εἶπεν Ἄχαζ· Οὐ μὴ αἰτήσω οὐδ᾿ οὐ μὴ πειράσω κύριον. Καὶ εἶπεν Ἡσαίας· Ἀκούετε δή, οἶκος Δαυΐδ. Μὴ μικρὸν ὑμῖν ἀγῶνα παρέχειν ἀνθρώποις; Καὶ πῶς κυρίῳ παρέχετε ἀγῶνα; Διὰ τοῦτο δώσει κύριος αὐτὸς ὑμῖν σημεῖον· ἰδοὺ ἡ παρθένος ἐν γαστρὶ λήψεται καὶ τέξεται υἱόν, καὶ καλέσεται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἐμμανουήλ. Βούτυρον καὶ μέλι φάγεται. Πρὶν ἢ γνῶναι αὐτὸν ἢ προελέσθαι πονηρὰ ἐκλέξεται τὸ ἀγαθόν· διότι, πρὶν ἢ γνῶναι τὸ παιδίον ἀγαθὸν ἢ κακόν. ἀπειθεῖ πονηρὰ τοῦ ἐκλέξασθαι τὸ ἀγαθόν. Διότι, πρὶν ἢ γνῶναι τὸ παιδίον καλεῖν πατέρα ἢ μητέρα, λήψεται δύναμιν Δαμασκοῦ καὶ σκύλα Σαμαρείας ἔναντι βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων. Καὶ καταληφθήσεται ἡ γῆ, ἣν σὺ σκληρῶς οἴσεις ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν δύο βασιλέων. Ἀλλ᾿ ἐπάξει ὁ θεὸς ἐπὶ σὲ καἰ ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν σου καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός σου ἡμέρας. αἳ οὐδέπω ἥκασιν ἐπὶ σέ, ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ᾗς ἀφεῖλεν Ἐφραῒμ ἀπὸ Ἰούδα τὸν βασιλέα τῶν Ἀσσυρίων [Is., XVII. 10-16a; VIII, 4; VII, 16 b-17]. Ὅτι μὲν οὖν ἐν τῷ γένει τῷ κατὰ σάρκα τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ οὐδεὶς ουδέποτε ἀπὸ παρθένου γεγέννηται οὐδὲ λέλεκται γεγεννημένος ἀλλ᾿ ἢ οὗτος ὁ ἡμέτερος Χριστός, πᾶσι φανερόν ἐστιν. Ἐπεὶ δὲ ὑμεῖς καὶ οἱ διδάσκαλοι ὑμῶν τολμᾶτε λέγειν μηδὲ εἰρῆσθαι ἐν τῇ προφητείᾳ τοῦ Ἡσαΐου Ἰδοὺ ἡ παρθένος ἐν γαστρὶ ἕξει, ἀλλ᾿ Ἰδοὺ ἡ νεᾶνις ἐν γαστρὶ λήψεται καὶ τέξεται υἱόν, καὶ ἐξηγεῖσθε τὴν προφητείαν ὡς εἰς Ἐζεκίαν, τὸν γενόμενον ὑμῶν βασιλέα, πειράσομαι καὶ ἐν τούτῳ καθ᾿ ὑμῶν βραχέα ἐξηγήσασθαι καὶ ἀποδεῖξαι εἰς τοῦτον εἰρῆσθαι τὸν ὁμολογούμενον ὑφ᾿ ἡμῶν Χριστόν.
pass_a_gloss: So then circumcision began from Abraham and the Sabbath and sacrifices and offerings and festivals from Moses, and it was shown because of the hardness of heart of your people that these things were commanded, thus it was necessary to cease according to the plan of the Father for the Son of God Christ who was born from the genus of Adam and the tribe of Judah and David through a virgin, who also is the eternal law and the new covenant to the whole world, which was proclaimed beforehand, as the prophecies previously spoken signify. And we who have come to God through Him did not receive this circumcision according to the flesh, but a spiritual one, which Enoch and those like him kept; we however received it through baptism, since we had become sinners, through the mercy from God, and it is given to all to receive equally. Now concerning the mystery of His generation, I speak because it is necessary to speak. Isaiah then spoke about the genus of Christ, that it is inexplicable to men, and he said as it is written: 'Who will declare His generation? For His life is taken away from the earth, He was led to death because of the iniquities of my people.' Since then the genus of this one who is about to die is inexplicable, so that we sinners may be healed by His bruise, the prophetic Spirit said these things. And also so that believing people may know in what manner He came into the world, born, the prophetic Spirit prophesied through Isaiah beforehand as it was going to happen: 'And the Lord added to speak to Ahaz, saying: Ask for yourself a sign from the Lord your God, either in depth or in height.' And Ahaz said: 'I will not ask, nor will I test the Lord.' And Isaiah said: 'Hear, house of David, will you give little trouble to men? And how do you give trouble to the Lord? Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign: behold, the virgin will conceive in the womb and bear a son, and she will call His name Emmanuel. He will eat butter and honey. Before He knows to choose good or evil, He will choose the good. For before the child knows good or evil, He will reject the evil to choose the good. Before the child knows to call father or mother, He will take the power of Damascus and the spoils of Samaria in the presence of the king of the Assyrians.' And the land which you will possess with difficulty before the face of the two kings will be taken, but God will bring upon you and your people and the house of your father days which have not yet come upon you, from the day on which Ephraim was taken away from Judah by the king of the Assyrians. For it is clear to all that in the fleshly genus of Abraham no one has ever been born from a virgin, nor has it been said that anyone was born, except this our Christ. Since you and your teachers dare to say that it is not said in the prophecy of Isaiah 'Behold, the virgin will have in the womb' but 'Behold, the young woman will conceive in the womb and bear a son', and you interpret the prophecy as if it were about Hezekiah, who became your king, I will try also in this to explain briefly against you and show that it was said about the Christ who is confessed by us.

pass_b_english: Since circumcision began with Abraham, and the Sabbath, and the sacrifices, and the offerings, and the festivals began with Moses, and it was shown that these things were commanded because of the hardness of heart of your people, it was necessary to cease according to the plan of the Father for the Son of God Christ, who was born from the seed of Adam and the tribe of Judah and David through a virgin, and who also proclaimed the eternal law and the new covenant to the whole world, as the previously spoken prophecies signify.

And we, who have joined ourselves to God through Him, did not receive this circumcision according to the flesh, but a spiritual one, which Enoch and those like him kept; we, however, received it through baptism, since we had become sinners, through the mercy of God, and it is given to all to receive it equally.

Now concerning the mystery of His birth, I speak because it is necessary to speak. Isaiah then spoke about the generation of Christ, that it is inexplicable to men, and he said as it is written: 'Who will declare His generation? For His life is taken away from the earth, He was led to death because of the iniquities of my people.' (Isaiah 53:8) Since then the generation of this one who is about to die is inexplicable, so that we sinners may be healed by His bruise, the prophetic Spirit said these things.

And also so that believing people may know in what manner He came into the world, born, the prophetic Spirit prophesied through Isaiah beforehand as it was going to happen: 'And the Lord added to speak to Ahaz, saying: Ask for yourself a sign from the Lord your God, either in depth or in height.' (Isaiah 7:11) And Ahaz said: 'I will not ask, nor will I test the Lord.' And Isaiah said: 'Hear, house of David, will you give little trouble to men? And how do you give trouble to the Lord? Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign: behold, the virgin will conceive in the womb and bear a son, and she will call His name Emmanuel. He will eat butter and honey. Before the child knows to choose good or evil, He will choose the good. For before the child knows good or evil, He will reject the evil to choose the good. Before the child knows to call father or mother, He will take the power of Damascus and the spoils of Samaria in the presence of the king of the Assyrians.' (Isaiah 7:16) And the land which you will possess with difficulty before the face of the two kings will be taken, but God will bring upon you and your people and the house of your father days which have not yet come upon you, from the day on which Ephraim was taken away from Judah by the king of the Assyrians. (Isaiah 8:4)

For it is clear to all that in the fleshly generation of Abraham no one has ever been born from a virgin, nor has it been said that anyone was born, except this our Christ. Since you and your teachers dare to say that it is not said in the prophecy of Isaiah 'Behold, the virgin will have in the womb' but 'Behold, the young woman will conceive in the womb and bear a son', and you interpret the prophecy as if it were about Hezekiah, who became your king, I will try also in this to explain briefly against you and show that it was said about the Christ who is confessed by us.
